MinETRO Test Launcher includes a self-contained Microsoft .NET 8 Windows Desktop runtime.
.NET Runtime / Windows Forms / Windows Presentation Foundation are distributed under MIT terms.
The license texts and runtime third-party notices are included in this directory.
Upstream notice sources (release/8.0):
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/release/8.0/LICENSE.TXT
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/release/8.0/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.TXT
https://github.com/dotnet/winforms/blob/release/8.0/LICENSE.TXT
https://github.com/dotnet/wpf/blob/release/8.0/LICENSE.TXT

Prism Launcher is not bundled in this application archive. The original official portable ZIP
is downloaded separately on request, with SHA256 verification and its own notices preserved.
Prism source and licensing: https://github.com/PrismLauncher/PrismLauncher/tree/11.1.1
The MinETRO shell does not claim affiliation with Prism, Microsoft or Mojang.
No complete Minecraft modpack or third-party closed mod distribution is included yet.
